The Subtask Name: Locate the Universe Today article and identify the linked paper
Agents_edges:
- From_agent: WebSurfer
  To_agent: WebSurfer
  agent_dependency_type: loop_control
  agent_strength: 0.95
  agent_explanation: The agent repeatedly executes 'scroll_down' actions (steps 4-12) without finding the link, indicating a self-reinforcing loop where the same action is taken without verifying progress or changing strategy.
  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: loop_issue
      description: Continuous scrolling without detecting the target link or reaching the bottom of the page causes the agent to waste steps and potentially miss the link if it is not at the very bottom or if the page structure is non-linear.
      severity: 0.85
      if_from_agent_wrong: The agent continues scrolling indefinitely or stops prematurely before finding the link, preventing the transition to the next subtask.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The subtask fails to complete, and the agent cannot proceed to access the paper.
